targeted: First bounded remediation unit of F-MD-B18-A002-016, per canonical package ordering (C2-backfill, the sole remaining implementation step in the C1->C2->C3 chain): PUBLICATION_EXACT backfill must use an explicitly declared immutable publication identity, never one derived from the current pointer and then passed as though it were explicit. Two predicates -- MD-S050-R0027 and MD-S003-R0002 -- reviewed and proven independently.

authority_reviewed.MD-S050-R0027: Replay_Verification_Contract_LOCKED.md line 52, section 'Resolution rules': 'Publication replay starts from explicit publication identity, never latest/current. Current-read verification is a separate assertion that the pointer resolves a specific publication.'
authority_reviewed.MD-S003-R0002: Historical_Replay_and_Data_Quality_Backtest.md line 11, section 'Exact publication verification': 'resolve an explicit immutable publication, not latest/current;'
authority_reviewed.D-MD-B18-A002-005_Q3: 'historical/backfill verification uses explicit publication/fixture identity, including publication_id wherever required. No latest/current substitution. Any current-read verification is a separate operation/semantic contract, not a fallback for historical verification.' This decided the remedy direction F-016's own text left open: the backfill takes explicit identities via a declared manifest, rather than being reclassified as current-read verification.

defect_confirmed_before_change.mechanism: findCurrentPublicationForTradeDate($tradeDate) resolved each date's publication from the current pointer; that pointer-derived publication_id was then passed as the 4th positional argument to ReplayVerificationService::verifyRunAgainstFixture(), which treats any non-null caller-supplied id as explicit (line 78: '$publicationId !== null ? (int) $publicationId : ...') with no check against the fixture manifest's own declared identity -- laundering a pointer lookup into an apparently explicit identity.
defect_confirmed_before_change.trigger: a correction moves eod_current_publication_pointer for a trade date between fixture creation and command execution
defect_confirmed_before_change.observed_behaviour_before_fix: the backfill silently verified whichever publication was current at execution time, not the one the fixture was created against
defect_confirmed_before_change.scope: local to ReplayBackfillService's call site; ReplayVerificationService's own refusal (REPLAY_EXPLICIT_PUBLICATION_REQUIRED) already existed and was already correct -- it refuses when NO id is supplied at all, but had no way to know the supplied id was pointer-derived rather than genuinely declared

MD-S050-R0027.implementation_change: ReplayBackfillService::execute no longer calls findCurrentPublicationForTradeDate. The fixture directory itself is now the declared manifest: {fixtureRoot}/{tradeDate}/publication_{N} names the immutable publication that date's replay targets, discovered by scanning the date directory (never computed from a live lookup) via the new private explicitPublicationIdFromFixture() method, and resolved via EodPublicationRepository::buildManifestByPublicationId() -- a pre-existing, unmodified, pure identity-keyed lookup with no pointer/current concept at all.
MD-S050-R0027.actual_identity_source: the publication_<id> subdirectory name under {fixtureRoot}/{tradeDate}/, frozen at fixture-creation time, never re-derived at execution time
MD-S050-R0027.refusal_behaviour: zero declared publication_<id> directories -> REPLAY_BACKFILL_EXPLICIT_PUBLICATION_UNDECLARED (refused before any replay work); more than one -> REPLAY_BACKFILL_EXPLICIT_PUBLICATION_AMBIGUOUS; a declared id that does not exist in the database -> REPLAY_BACKFILL_EXPLICIT_PUBLICATION_NOT_FOUND; a declared id whose real trade_date disagrees with the directory it was found under -> REPLAY_BACKFILL_EXPLICIT_PUBLICATION_TRADE_DATE_MISMATCH. All four reject before verifyRunAgainstFixture or exportReplayEvidence are ever called.

MD-S003-R0002.implementation_change: None. ReplayVerificationService::verifyRunAgainstFixture already refused a READABLE-expected PUBLICATION_EXACT replay with no explicit id (REPLAY_EXPLICIT_PUBLICATION_REQUIRED). The gap was purely in proof: the only guard, B18ReplayContractStaticGuardTest::test_exact_missing_publication_fails_closed, was a static source-text check asserting the reason-code string and the textual absence of one specific literal call pattern -- it never executed the refusal.
MD-S003-R0002.actual_identity_source: unchanged: caller-supplied 4th argument, else fixture manifest's own publication_id, else expected_publication_context.publication_id, else refused
MD-S003-R0002.refusal_behaviour: for a READABLE-expected run with no explicit id resolvable from any of those three sources, REPLAY_EXPLICIT_PUBLICATION_REQUIRED fires before resolveExplicitFixturePublication or resolvePublicationForReplayActualState (the pointer-consulting fallback) is ever called -- proven by leaving findCurrentPublicationForTradeDate, findReadableCurrentPublicationForRun, and resolvePublicationForEvidenceAudit entirely unstubbed on the mocked collaborators, so an unexpected call to any of them fails the test on its own

full_range_current_evidence_replay_servi.finding: FullRangeCurrentEvidenceReplayService also derives publicationId from findCurrentPublicationForTradeDate, matching the surface pattern F-016 describes, but it is not the same defect. Its own summary explicitly declares 'assertion_scope' => 'current_readable_publication_per_trading_date', and its suite name is market_data_full_range_current_evidence_replay -- a self-declared, explicit 'verify whatever is current, per date' operation, not a claim of historical exact identity.
full_range_current_evidence_replay_servi.authority_basis: this is precisely the second disposition F-016's own remedy names: 'the backfill is reclassified as current-read verification, which then needs the separate pointer assertion R0027 names' -- except this service was already built that way from the start and already carries that separate, explicit classification (assertion_scope + the CURRENT_READABLE_PUBLICATION_AUDIT / replay_actual_resolution_mode labelling that flows through into its exported evidence), unlike ReplayBackfillService, which mixed the two operations with no classification at all.
full_range_current_evidence_replay_servi.disposition: left unmodified; documented here and in F-016 as the reviewed disposition, not implemented in this bounded unit per explicit scope instruction

tests_changed.ReplayBackfillServiceTest_rewrite: the two tests that pinned pointer-derived selection (findCurrentPublicationForTradeDate mocked and asserted-called) rewritten against the corrected contract; every test in the file now asserts $publications->shouldNotReceive('findCurrentPublicationForTradeDate'). Four new tests added: undeclared publication (REPLAY_BACKFILL_EXPLICIT_PUBLICATION_UNDECLARED before any work), ambiguous declaration (two publication_<id> dirs, REPLAY_BACKFILL_EXPLICIT_PUBLICATION_AMBIGUOUS), declared id that does not exist (REPLAY_BACKFILL_EXPLICIT_PUBLICATION_NOT_FOUND), and declared id whose real trade_date disagrees with the fixture directory (REPLAY_BACKFILL_EXPLICIT_PUBLICATION_TRADE_DATE_MISMATCH). One new positive test, test_pointer_moving_after_fixture_creation_does_not_retarget_the_replay, proves the core discriminating scenario the finding names: fixture declares P61, findCurrentPublicationForTradeDate is never called at all (shouldNotReceive), replay targets P61 regardless of what the (unconsulted) pointer would now resolve to.
tests_changed.ReplayVerificationServiceTest_additions: two new tests for MD-S003-R0002: test_publication_exact_refuses_a_readable_expectation_with_no_explicit_publication_id_before_any_pointer_lookup (negative -- refusal fires, pointer/current-lookup methods left unstubbed so an unexpected call itself fails the test) and test_publication_exact_accepts_a_readable_expectation_with_a_genuinely_explicit_publication_id (positive control -- a genuinely explicit id resolves successfully, proving the boundary is not reject-everything).
